functions.keep_route_reservation:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.keep_route_reservation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'резервирования публичных адресов постоянны' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
functions.lock_languages:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_languages(codes text[])
 RETURNS SETOF public.languages
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT l.* FROM public.languages AS l WHERE l.code = ANY(codes)
 ORDER BY l.code COLLATE "C" FOR SHARE OF l;
$function$

triggers.article_draft_translations.article_draft: CREATE TRIGGER article_drafts_reset_ready BEFORE UPDATE ON public.article_draft_translations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.reset_draft_ready()
triggers.article_revision_translations.article_re: CREATE TRIGGER article_revision_translations_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.article_revision_translations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_revision_translation()
triggers.article_revisions.article_revisions_clos: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER article_revisions_closed AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.article_revisions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.require_closed_revision()
triggers.article_revisions.article_revisions_guar: CREATE TRIGGER article_revisions_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.article_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_revision()
triggers.articles.articles_published_guard: CREATE TRIGGER articles_published_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF published_revision_id, id ON public.articles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_published_revision()
triggers.public_routes.public_routes_permanent: CREATE TRIGGER public_routes_permanent BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.public_routes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.keep_route_reservation()

views.public_article_routes:
SELECT r.language_code,
    r.slug,
    r.article_id,
    t.slug AS current_slug,
    t.revision_id
   FROM (public.public_routes r
     JOIN public.public_article_translations t ON (((t.article_id = r.article_id) AND (t.language_code = r.language_code))));
views.public_article_translations:
SELECT t.article_id,
    t.revision_id,
    t.language_code,
    t.title,
    t.slug,
    t.body_markdown
   FROM ((public.article_revision_translations t
     JOIN public.articles a ON (((a.id = t.article_id) AND (a.published_revision_id = t.revision_id))))
     JOIN public.languages l ON (((l.code = t.language_code) AND l.is_enabled)));
views.public_languages:
SELECT code,
    name,
    native_name,
    direction
   FROM public.languages
  WHERE is_enabled;
